fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Turns on the Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp catalog. Off: nothing is sent to Meta.

fields.label: Catalog ID
fields.description: Numeric ID from Meta Commerce Manager (e.g. 1234567890123456)

fields.label: Reuse Token From WhatsApp Account
fields.description: Optional. Uses the connection of this WhatsApp account instead of a separate key.

fields.label: Meta Access Token
fields.description: Meta access key with catalog permission (and WhatsApp permission if you also send products from here).

fields.label: Default Brand
fields.description: Blank uses the default company name.

fields.label: Default Condition
fields.options:
new
refurbished
used
used_like_new
used_good
used_fair

fields.label: Default Visibility
fields.description: staging = synced to the catalog but NOT shown on public Facebook/Instagram (review in Commerce Manager first). published = live to shoppers. Start with staging; flip to published + run Sync All Now when ready, or override per item group in the Category & Condition Mapping below.

fields.label: Default Availability
fields.options:
in stock
out of stock
preorder
available for order
discontinued

fields.label: Price Markup %
fields.description: Optional positive percent added to the REAL selling price (Item Price in the selling price list) before publishing. Default 0 = Meta price matches the live shop exactly.

fields.label: Sync Only Website Items (deprecated)
fields.description: DEPRECATED / no-op. The catalog now always mirrors the storefront gate (Item.publish_on_web=1 AND not disabled), so this flag is ignored. Kept only to avoid a data migration; remove in a later cleanup.

fields.label: Public Image URL Base
fields.description: Public address of your shop for the photos (e.g. https://mitienda.mx). Empty = this site's address.

fields.label: Fallback Image URL
fields.description: Used when an Item has no image. Public HTTPS PNG/JPG, square aspect ratio recommended (max 8 MB).

fields.label: Category & Condition Mapping
fields.description: Optional. Set the condition (new, refurbished…) and the Google category for each item group. Groups without a row use the Default Condition above.

fields.label: Variant Grouping
fields.description: How a template's variants are grouped into Meta products. Blank = one product per template (named after the template).

fields.label: Group-By Attribute
fields.description: Item Attribute that splits a template into separate Meta products, e.g. 'Modelos Celulares' -> one product per phone model (title becomes 'Template Model'). Blank = one product per template.

fields.label: Color / Option Attribute
fields.description: Item Attribute mapped to Meta's variant option, e.g. 'Color'. Blank = no variant option.

fields.label: Inbound / Conversational
fields.description: WhatsApp menu and chat-link tracking. Both start off; turn them on per shop. The menu can work alongside automatic replies.

fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Menu
fields.description: When the customer taps a menu button (Catálogo / Pedir / Pagar), reply with the matching message.

fields.label: Checkout / Pay URL
fields.description: The off-Meta payment link (e.g. a Mercado Pago checkout) sent as a CTA-URL button when a customer taps Pagar. MX has no native WhatsApp checkout.

fields.label: Track Chat Links
fields.description: Records which WhatsApp chat link the customer came from.

fields.label: Business WhatsApp Number
fields.description: Business WhatsApp number with country code (e.g. 5216691234567) for chat links.

fields.label: Create Lead From WhatsApp Form
fields.description: When a customer completes a WhatsApp form, create a lead with the answers.

fields.label: Intake Flow ID
fields.description: Only act on completions of THIS WhatsApp Flow id (blank = any flow). Set it to the repair-intake flow so other flows don't create leads.

fields.label: Attach Customer Photos to Repair Order
fields.description: Attach a photo or video the customer sends to their open repair order (e.g. a cracked screen). Does nothing if the customer has no open repair order.

fields.label: Ad Conversions
fields.description: Sends sales and new leads to a Meta dataset (Pixel) to measure ads. Uses its own dataset key, not the catalog key. Off by default.

fields.label: Send Conversions to Meta
fields.description: Tells Meta about sales and new leads (customer data is protected) to measure ads.

fields.label: Dataset / Pixel ID
fields.description: Numeric dataset ID from Meta Events Manager.

fields.label: Purchase Action Source
fields.description: Where a sale is reported from when the customer did not come from a WhatsApp ad. Sales from a WhatsApp ad are always reported as WhatsApp.

fields.label: Dataset Access Token
fields.description: Access key for this dataset (Events Manager › Settings › Generate access token). Separate from the catalog key.

fields.label: Test Event Code
fields.description: Optional. From Events Manager > Test Events. When set, every event is sent as a test (visible there, not counted as real). Clear it to go live.
